label: Над
description: The preposition над/надо ('over/above') + instrumental: physical position above and the figurative работать над / смеяться над.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Spatial position above. 1. 'Над столом' is над plus the instrumental of стол. 2. 'Лампа висит' names the subject hanging above. 3. A clean physical above-line.
Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над городом' uses над with the instrumental of город. 2. 'Небо раскинулось' sits over the city. 3. A wide spatial scene.
Strategic focus: Spatial span above. 1. 'Над рекой' is над with the instrumental of река. 2. 'Мост висит' crosses above the water. 3. A concrete above-position phrase.
Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над водой' uses над plus the instrumental of вода. 2. 'Птица кружит' flies over the surface. 3. A simple spatial line.
Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над лесом' is над with the instrumental of лес. 2. 'Облако плывёт' floats over the forest. 3. A vertical spatial relation.

missions.phrase: У нас есть крыша над головой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над головой' uses над plus the instrumental of голова. 2. 'Крыша' shelters from above. 3. An everyday above-line idiom.
Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над морем' is над with the instrumental of море. 2. 'Солнце садится' hangs over the sea. 3. A bright spatial scene.
Strategic focus: Position above. 1. 'Над дверью' uses над plus the instrumental of дверь. 2. 'Свет горит' marks the spot above. 3. A compact above-line.
Strategic focus: Figurative над. 1. 'Над проектом' is над with the instrumental of проект. 2. 'Работаю над' means working on something. 3. Same case, abstract sense.
Strategic focus: Figurative над. 1. 'Над шуткой' uses над plus the instrumental of шутка. 2. Над here marks what one laughs at. 3. Abstract, not spatial.

missions.phrase: Я долго думаю над этой задачей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Figurative над. 1. 'Над задачей' is над with the instrumental of задача. 2. Над here means pondering over a problem. 3. Same case, mental sense.
Strategic focus: Figurative над. 1. 'Над книгой' uses над plus the instrumental of книга. 2. Над marks what moves one to tears. 3. Abstract emotional sense.
Strategic focus: Figurative над. 1. 'Над докладом' is над with the instrumental of доклад. 2. 'Трудимся над' means labouring on a report. 3. Abstract working sense.
Strategic focus: Position above with надо. 1. Before the cluster 'мной' над becomes надо. 2. 'Мной' is the instrumental of я. 3. Spatial above-position.
Strategic focus: Figurative надо. 1. Before 'всеми' над becomes надо. 2. 'Всеми' is the instrumental of все. 3. Над marks who is mocked.
